authoritative_replay.effort_assignment: world-local exposure index; round k updates world 0 then world 2 with effort_cycle[k mod 4]
authoritative_replay.probe_round_selection: exact union of parent EXP-329 direct-damage rounds
authoritative_replay.parent_reproduction_requirement: final model, optimizer and RNG digests plus registered world outcomes must exactly match EXP-329

parameter_partition.partition_rule: every trainable A_FIXED named parameter belongs to exactly one registered group; unknown or empty groups invalidate the court
parameter_partition.tied_output_note: A_FIXED logits use backbone.token_embedding.weight as output weight; the tied matrix remains one resident parameter and is assigned only to embedding_output

probe.gradient_measurement: answer-only world0/world2 gradients from the identical pre-round state, decomposed by registered parameter group
probe.masked_update_measurement: deep-clone model+optimizer, compute the ordinary full source gradient, apply the ordinary global clip, clear gradients outside one registered group so AdamW skips those parameters, then apply one optimizer step and evaluate source/target at the same effort
probe.directed_damage_rule: selected-group source update must improve source loss by at least self_improvement_epsilon and increase target loss by at least cross_damage_epsilon

interpretation.SINGLE_GROUP_BIDIRECTIONAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: exactly one registered parameter group exhibits at least one direct-damage event in each direction and no other group exhibits registered direct damage
interpretation.MULTI_GROUP_CROSS_DAMAGE: multiple registered groups are implicated, including at least one group with bidirectional direct damage
interpretation.DIRECTIONALLY_SPLIT_GROUP_CROSS_DAMAGE: both directions are represented across registered groups but no single group is bidirectionally damaging
interpretation.ONE_DIRECTION_GROUP_CROSS_DAMAGE: registered group-isolated damage appears in only one source direction
interpretation.NO_GROUP_LOCAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: the parent full-update interference reproduces but no isolated registered group independently meets the direct-damage rule

nonclaims: EXP-330 does not intervene on authoritative training
EXP-330 does not establish that freezing, projecting or routing any group would improve learning
EXP-330 does not establish universal gradient conflict outside the registered P02 trajectory
EXP-330 does not establish an architectural capacity ceiling
EXP-330 does not establish that scaling would help
EXP-330 does not authorize EXP-302 or EXP-320
